test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A deposited ₹1,56,250 at 8% simple interest for 2 years. How much more money will A have in his account at the end of two years, if at the same rate of interest the sum is invested in compound interest, compounded annually
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs.156250

Time = 2 years ; Rate% = 8% 

**Formula used:**

S.I = (P × R × T)/100

C.I = P × effective rate for T years

For C.I:

Effective rate for 2 years = R₁ + R₂ + {(R₁ × R₂)/100}

Where, S.I = simple interest ; C.I = compound interest

and P = principal ; R = rate ; T = time 

**Calculation:**

Effective rate for 2 years = (8 × 2)% = 16%

⇒ S.I = 156250 × 16%

The effective rate for 2 years = 8 + 8 + (8 × 8)/100

⇒ 16 + 0.64 = 16.64%

C.I = 156250 × 16.64%

Required difference = 156250 × (16.64 - 16)

⇒ 156250 × 0.64% = Rs.1000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.1000.**
